points: This course offers eight steps of attention practice.
The largest review for medical decision-making by Goyal et al. in JAMA Internal Medicine 2014 included 47 clinical trials and 3,515 people.
It shows mindfulness programmes have a small effect on anxiety d≈0.38, depression d≈0.30, and pain d≈0.33 against active controls.
These numbers were missing for a long time because 84% of clinical trials never asked about adverse events.
This is according to Wong et al. as cited in Baer et al., 2019.
This is not a ban or a filter but a method of routing.
Contact a living professional if the heaviness persists beyond the session.
